interpretation.failure_to_success: The unconditioned always-probe/entropy choices can pay for an observation outside its decision-value threshold; cheap-exact and two-step Bellman switch at Delta=.4 on the default grid.
interpretation.same_mi_caveat: Equal-MI H/U is a tie; favoring U is an allowed but unfavorable tie-break, not a universal entropy failure.
interpretation.scope: This is a standard binary Bayes threshold mechanism, not a claim of novel VOI theory, complete B, or real robot performance.

protocol.tie_rule: terminal ties choose minus; probe ties choose skip
